decisions.reason: A navigation and observation camera close to the firm's heritage, with its own page, is cheap to maintain, and long space procurement cycles mean its value is still resolving, so the option stays open.
The modular multi-model camera line underpins the firm's small-satellite strategy and holds several growth options at low marginal cost.
Space situational awareness remains a growing but uncertain market, and two years reveal too little to justify abandoning an extension of existing competencies.
The miniaturized LiDAR is still only mentioned, which signals an early stage, but it fits the docking and small-satellite direction and costs little to keep while its uncertainty resolves.
The new radiation-hard camera line has its own page and is close to the core offer, so as a fresh option with high uncertainty and low holding cost it should clearly be kept.
The asteroid navigation camera is a newly mentioned, mission-driven extension whose value depends on long-horizon exploration programs, so it is too early to abandon this cheap option.
